stage: D08 complete, exploratory fixed input panel and existing frozen FIT predictions

frozen_input_pair_outcome_descriptives.selection: Exactly the input-only accepted pairs; all failures retained in frozen input manifest; no outcome reselection
frozen_input_pair_outcome_descriptives.definitions: Endpoint peaks use each endpoint observed support; trajectory contrasts use common observed hours at corresponding forecast-relative phases, not necessarily the same absolute clock. Signed differences are anchor minus partner. Model peak_lag_difference is the error in predicted timing contrast, not the true timing contrast.
frozen_input_pair_outcome_descriptives.interpretation: Dependent deterministic input pairs, not matched causal comparisons or population risk; infrastructure/background not balanced

symptom_replication.interpretation: Partial numerical/mechanism panel; cannot be the only candidate-screen gate.

definitions.severe_hour_count: Count of observed hours >=0.1; may be disjoint
definitions.max_contiguous_run: Longest consecutive observed >=0.1 run; missing hours break runs
definitions.rise_fall: Observed adjacent difference with hour71 origin included for hour72; no wrap or interpolation
definitions.peak_lag: First observed predicted peak hour minus first observed true peak hour
definitions.half_height: Contiguous observed >=half of true peak episode containing the first peak; missing/forecast edges flag truncation
definitions.HT: Panel inclusion-probability numerator; fixed original FIT denominators, no inference interval
definitions.medians: Sampling-reweighted distributions are ratio estimators, not unbiased quantiles
definitions.quantile_convention: Peaks/outcome shapes: interpolate cumulative weight knots as D07 A/D06; cached controller points: midpoint knots as D07 B. Cached four-mode values are averaged per working point before distribution.
definitions.closed: Same frozen CRK exit closed, not independently trained host
definitions.parameter_step: Existing D07 weather block .001 relative parameter norm intervention, not small output guarantee

d08_pair_contrasts.csv.contents: Scalar fixed-input pair contrasts only; no original input or outcome/prediction trajectories
d08_pair_contrasts.csv.abs_true_peak_difference_median: Ordinary unweighted record median; endpoints and some unordered pairs repeat
d08_pair_contrasts.csv.publication_IO: LF line endings; original CRLF scalar export preserved locally, no values changed

limitations: All these predictions were trained on all6350 original FIT units; selected folds2-5 do not become new heldout evaluation.
HT is design-unbiased only for additive fixed-predictor totals, not roots/quantiles/sample concentration or training-model risk.
Input distance qualifies relative near/far support; it does not balance every meteorological coordinate, infrastructure or latent background.
All pair records retained, including repeated endpoints; dependent pairs do not prove geography causes the response contrast.
Input-only roster was not revised after observing imperfect symptom replication; full-D generalization and net geography remain unproved.
